endorsements.name: Mike Palafox
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-2629
endorsements.description: There is a DLL hijacking vulnerability due to an uncontrolled search path that exists in NI LabVIEW when loading NI Error Reporting.  This vulnerability may result in arbitrary code execution.  Successful exploitation requires an attacker to insert a malicious DLL into the uncontrolled search path.  This vulnerability affects NI LabVIEW 2025 Q1 and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 7.3)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
